criteria.evidence: web/tests/e2e/30-account-dashboard.spec.ts reproduces the §8 state rows of dashboard.md in Chromium against the live database: no access (guest redirected to /login?next=/me), blocked (GET /me of a self-archived session answers 302 to /me/archived), loading (bookmarks read held by a route stub so the skeleton is observable) and empty (base plan, Create article link to /me/articles/new, read invitation, no admin link, no e-mail), plan limit (expired grant: renew to /pricing, read-only note, no Create article), data error for a zone (bookmarks fail, other cards stay) and for me (500 page with requestId on client navigation); plus an active plan with its queue line and the needs-attention zone with the latest pieces. 'Not found' is not applicable per the spec and 'Paywall' is reserved. CI run 35555642245: the browser job went from 179 to 188 tests with skipped unchanged at 9 and passed rising from 170 to 179, so all nine new scenarios passed.

The same file asserts that GET /me of an admin service record answers 302 with Location on /admin and the browser lands in the admin area. server/tests/account-dashboard.test.ts asserts that a service record gets no plan (subscription null) and that the dashboard fields are served to the owner only.

checks.playwright: not run locally: the local Docker daemon answers HTTP 500 to its own client and no local Postgres exists; the CI browser job ran the new scenarios — 179 passed / 9 skipped out of 188

deployment.reason: The task adds no Prisma migration and does not change the database schema; the new resolvers ship with the ordinary server build

remaining: Independent native review of the tested SHA is pending; Done stays with the controller. A pre-merge review by a separate agent (not a native review) found three defects on 73ed819 that were fixed in 3c5f0d0

Out-of-scope defect: createArticle creates the article together with a nested source translation while the t015_sync_legacy_article insert trigger creates the same (articleId, locale) translation, so 'Create article' should fail on a real database; every existing browser scenario mocks the API. The click scenario was dropped from T-030; a separate task with a live-database check is needed

Side fix: an access cookie the API no longer recognises made SSR loop /me -> /login -> /me; useAuthSession().clear() now deletes the session cookies in the response before the redirect. noindex-meta.spec.ts now uses a real session instead of a token without sid
The /me/archived screen referenced by the blocked row still does not exist in the repository, as for T-022, T-025 and T-032
There is no reeditTranslation mutation yet, so the re-edit window row links to the piece instead of opening the confirmation dialog
/me/settings, /me/subscription, /me/export and /me/delete are not built yet; the links follow the routes registry

[ДОПУЩЕНИЕ] §9 collapsed plan card and phone bottom navigation are not implemented; unreadDecisions is not a separate field, the needs-attention zone derives unread decisions from myArticles (first 20 pieces under check, rejected or published by update time)
